avis.texte: I found this eye cream from reading Wirecutter in the NYT They said it was the best and of the less expensive eye creams for fine lines. It works! Surprised a thrilled!!

Nothing about this product does what it says. I use this everynight and faithfully, with no noticible change. Once this is done, im not buying this again. I only gave two stars for how thick it is when you need that.

avis.titre: Dried up in applicator before finishing product.
avis.texte: There are better eye creams out there. I wanted to love this one for the price, but the cooling applicator tip is now clogged. I have to remove the entire top of the tube to get any product out.

This is one of my skincare routine products. I first got it after learning that regular lotion is not meant to be used in the eye area. I was skeptical until a milia that I had tried to get rid of for years slowly shrunk until it was gone.
My sister recommended this eye cream and I LOVE it! The applicator is amazing and cooling. I have been using it for months and provides hydration.

I initially purchased this after seeing it highly recommended by one of my favorite skincare influencers. It's since become my new favorite eye cream and I've repurchased it several times over. To be honest I don't care too much for the applicator but the cream itself is thick and hydrating and has never irritated my eyes. My main complaint is that no matter how well I think I've squeezed every last drop out of the tube there's still a good amount of product left in it. I started cutting my tubes open when I'm "done" with it and scooping the remnants into a small jar for travel. You would be shocked how much is still in there! I definitely recommend doing this to anyone who uses this product. Takes me less than five minutes and no product goes to waste
Love the applicator but its been a month and haven't noticed any changes.
I liked the applicator but this is not good for sensitive skin. My under eyes broke out really bad after using 2-3 days. It took about a week for my under eyes to go back to normal :(
The applicator feels great gliding across the under eye area. The cream is rich and thick but a little greasy if it gets too close to eye. The area feels more plump and smooth after using.
I have pretty deep eye bags and this helps brighten my under eyes and firms the skin

The formula and the applicator feel nice but this left the skin around my eyes red and irriated, even gave me little bumps. Tried it multiple times, gave it a break and tried it again and this happened every time. It could be that I'm just sensitive to it, may work for others.
My new favorite eye cream! I love the applicator because it is so cooling and makes the product easy to apply, but also helps with under eye puffiness.

I was really loving this until all of a sudden I wasnt - shards of metal came out of the applicator and scratched my under eye. Three shards so far. Its a shame, because the cream itself is lovely - hydrating but not heavy, non-irritating to my sensitive eyes, and actually felt like a much higher end cream. Until you know the shards.
I truly love this stuff! I have noticed such a difference under my eyes and the cold tip feels so good in the mornings.
Love it!! Such a good eye cream and love the metal applicator for a cooling effect.

I stayed away from eye creams due to recurring milia, but this one changed my mind. It absorbs into the skin quickly and the metal tip applicator feels lovely. I have very sensitive skin around my eyes that tends to get eczema patches and this did not irritate my skin.
I have tried MANY eye creams and this is my absolute favorite! I apply at night and in the morning and I see such a difference in my eye area.

The only eye cream that has helped my super burning eye skin. The only eye cream Ive ever been excited to purchase (twice now!). I was diagnosed with eczema recently but I was using this eye cream prior to it and it has been the only thing that helps cool and smooth my irritated delicate skin around my eyes. I will be purchasing this again and maybe even forever!
Great eye cream. Suitable for those with sensitive skin. Metal applicator is a great plus very soothing to apply!

This is really great for sensitive eyes. I love how thick it is and it doesn't feel like its pulling when I apply. I don't really utilize the silver tip for cooling or for application. If it made the product cheaper to not have it-I would like that.
This is a great eye cream for sensitive skin. The applicator is incredibly soothing.

I love how this is hydrating without being sticky or leaving any residue that may pill. The metal tip is a gamechanger because it helps depuff and feels like a massage. I have sensitive eyes and this does not irritate me at all.
I have tried many eye creams but this one responded the best to my under eyes. I have noticed a difference!
I was happy to find this product because Ive always had struggles with puffy under eyes and this is the only eye cream thats helped me. Also, I love the cooling tip and the cream itself feels lux

This eye cream is magical! I use it at the end of the day and in the morning. The metal applicator feels amazing on my under eyes and totally wakes me up in the morning! I feel like it leaves them feeling de-puffed, hydrated, and smooth.
The metal applicator is very cooling to the skin, the product itself makes my eye area feel nourished and very hydrated.

avis.titre: The ONLY eye cream that's worked for me
avis.texte: This is the ONLY eye cream that's actually worked for me. I haven't seen something this affordable produce real effects for me, but my undereyes feel consistently more hydrated. I also really love the metal cooling tip.
If my eyes are super dry and red, I swear this brings them back to life in 48 hrs!

eye cream, massager, cooling effect. The amount of benefits and perks this one product has, has changed the game for me when it comes to under eye care. a soothing cream with a cold to the touch eye applier that feels so nice when rubbing the product around. I feel so relax after applying it to my eyes. In the mornings it helps my tired eyes, de puff and look less tired and at night it helps them relax and feels soothing for bed. Best of both worlds. Definitely a product I cannot recommend enough.
I received this item and when i was going to use it, i pushed and pushed and very little came out. It came almost empty.
This eye cream actually fills in the fine lines! When I smile, I normally show the fine lines. With this eye cream, they are barely noticeable!

I have been using this product for almost 2 months and I have seen a significant change going from dark circles to bright under eyes no puffiness I feel rejuvenated after I complete my Facial care in the morning. Smooth and is not irritating my skin like some other products.

avis.titre: A treat for your tired, puffy eyes!
avis.texte: My mom has taught me that its never too early to start your night time eye cream so this is what I tried and I was so happy with it! I use it more as self care now then anything, the cool metal tip with the soothing lightweight cream feels like such a treat at the end of a long day!

The revitalizing eye cream is, hands down, my favorite eye cream. I use it every single night. The applicator feels amazing. The cream leaves my under eyes feeling soft, plump, and hydrated. No milia on these under eyes!

The cream itself is fine, it didn't really do much for me except moisturize. But the applicator and packaging are not good. The metal applicator is a nice idea, but it didn't work very well, it tugged at my skin rather than spreading the product. So I just applied with my hands, that's fine. But the worst part: after a few weeks, I noticed that the plastic rod inside the cap was starting to break down. There were little splinters of plastic coming off it. I was concerned that it may have shed plastic bits inside the tube (and I don't want that near my eyes!!) so I had to throw it away. I think cocokind should redesign the applicator and cap to prevent this!!

avis.titre: Pills around the eyes and looks dry
avis.texte: This was nice at first because of the applicator, but it pills off so easily and makes my eyes look dry. I'd rather just use my regular moisturizer.
My favorite eye cream! Doesnt cause irritation or milia around my eyes.

avis.titre: AMAZING for my eczema prone eyes
avis.texte: I got this as part of a gift set and didn't think much of it at first, since personally I think most eye creams are just overpriced moisturizers. And I pretty much never write reviews. BUT. I swear to god this is the first winter in like 5 years where I did not have an eczema flare up on my eyelids. I actually started to flare up on one eye in the couple days before I started using it, and it WENT AWAY after using this a day or two. I was flabbergasted lol. I've been using it morning and night since and didn't have a single flare up after that. Idk what is in this that makes it different since I have tried a ton of different creams short of a prescription and none have helped like this. As far as helping fine lines go can't say I've seen much help there. But will 1000% keep buying if it means it keeps my itchy eyelids at bay!! Definitely recommend trying if you also have dry sensitive eyes!!

I've gone through A LOT of eye creams and i gotta say this one hydrates my under eyes. I use morning and night and I have noticed the dry patch(psoriasis) under my left eye makes it go away. I have dry skin and do notice faintly it keeps it hydrated. For the price, ill keep using it because it does help a bit. The applicator, if using it correctly, only comes out a little; i haven't had any problems with a whole bunch coming out.

Love this! Have only been using it for a couple months, so I am not sure if it helps with dark circles, BUT i would still use it because that cool metal tip feels soooo good! And it's hydrating as well. Will keep buying
The metal applicator feels so good on my skin! It is a cool and refreshing feeling in the morning and helps depuff my eyes!

avis.titre: Not the best for under-eye circles
avis.texte: A decent hydrating eye cream, though I didn't notice a big improvement in my under-eye circles after a month of consistent use. Definitely not a bad product however, and lasted quite a long time as a little goes a long way.

I really liked the idea of a cooling, depuffing metal applicator for morning use. I found that in order to get the applicator to gently glide over the eye area, quite a lot of product is needed, leaving the area very wet with product, more product than i want under my eyes! I found a few hours later that the product pills and eventually got in my eye when touching/rubbing.

this eye cream is good and i think it brightens your eyes and if it wasnt for the applicator it would get 5 stars. but every week or so i have to squeeze my hardest to get it out bc there is built up cream and dry cream so when i squeeze a bunchcomes.
I love the applicator, as the cold feels so good on my skin, but I've been using this for months and haven't noticed a difference in the Dark circles or the fine lines.
My under eye area is super sensitive, so I struggle to find eye cream. But this doesn't irritate it at all, and it works!

I have been using this for 2.5 weeks and have fallen in love with it. I am 39, been through menopause, and have dry-normal skin. My undereyes have been a nightmare with concealers because they're always so dry. I have tried about 5 or 6 different eye creams but they either dried my undereyes out even worse, burned, or pilled with my makeup. This is the first eye cream product that is thin enough to absorb quickly and leaves my undereyes HYDRATED all day. I have been testing it with my color correctors, concealers, and with just powder foundation. At the end of the day the undereyes still look phenomenal. A bonus is the cooling effect of the metal tip applicator. If you don't like the idea of that, the metal tip applicator comes off and you can get the product straight from the tube. I like to put a few dots under each eye and gently rub it in with the metal applicator. The coolness helps with my puffiness in the mornings. Then I go in and tap and gently rub in with my ring fingers. I couldn't ask for a better product and at a fair price point. I'm in love with Coco Kind!

This is my first eye cream, which I bought to help my dark circles, as well as reduce fine lines as I get closer to my 30s. I've only been using this about a week or so, but it seems like my dark circles are starting to improve. Overall, this cream is nice and hydrating, plus the metal applicator feels nice and cool under my eyes. My favorite part of my skincare routine!

This is the only eye cream I've used that made a noticeable difference. I'm a barista and this makes my eyes bright, hydrated, and less puffy at 3 in the morning. It has a rich texture- a little goes a long way. The applicater is cold and feels nice. Looks great under makeup too.

Ive tried this multiple times over the past few weeks to be sure and each time, I would wake up in the morning with red, puffy, itchy undereyes. Otherwise, the cream is thick so it tugs a but when trying to spread with the applicator. It did feel nice and mousturizing once applied but cant use due to reaction.

I started using this cream daily to moisturize around my eyes in the harsh Chicago winter and now have milia around both eyes SO bad. This was the only new item I've incorporated in my skincare routine so I have reason to believe this cream is what caused it. Super bummed!

I wanted to love this product, but unfortunately it didn't hydrate my eyes. After about a week of use, my undereyes started getting flakey and red! I think this product triggered my eczema. For reference, I have sensitive combo skin!
This is genuinely one of the best eye creams I have ever used! The cool metal tip makes my under eyes feel so refreshed and I genuinely noticed a difference in my under eyes after applying it!

I really wanted to like this; I heard great things and it's a nice rich eye cream. However, something in it made my eyes itch uncontrollably all day. As soon as I stopped using it, the itching stopped. If you have sensitive eyes, look elsewhere.

I never write reviews but this product has been the only eye cream I've tried that has actually helped depuff my under eye bags. I've only ever tried affordable eye creams so i cant compare it to the crazy expensive ones, but each time i apply it, my under eye bags are less prominent than before and the effects last all day making me look less tired. The metal cooling tip is a nice, calming touch. I have not tried this product under makeup so i cant speak on that. I will definitely be buying again!

I love this eye cream! I have very sensitive eyes, and all other products I've tried irritated and burned. This one glides on smoothly and the metal applicator feels great. I also appreciate the price compared to many others that are far more expensive without results.
I never thought I could be obsessed with an eye cream...but this stuff is incredible. Love the applicator, love the thick formula, love how well it layers under makeup!
There is nothing that stands out about this product. There are way better products available for eye care.

avis.titre: Gentle formula, unusable during the day
avis.texte: Eye creams are always risky for me as I have very sensitive skin. This one didn't cause any reaction thankfully. Plus the applicator is a treat. However, it is unusable under makeup as it pills under any type of make up (even a veil of setting powder will cause it to break up and pill). It also pills by itself, which makes it difficult to enjoy at night as well. I won't be able to finish it, which is very sad…

avis.titre: Not meant for use under makeup
avis.texte: I tried to use this eye cream in so many ways (using the applicator to spread and massage a thin veil, dabbing rather than rubbing, with my fingers, letting dry and dabbing before sunscreen…). Unfortunately it pills so badly that I can't use it during the day (even if I'm not wearing any makeup). It is annoying to wear, evan at night. I will nor re-purchase

avis.titre: Cooling applicator, but pills under makeup
avis.texte: I really enjoyed the feeling of the applicator! I've tried some other products with a similar mechanism and this is the first to actually feel cooling on my skin. However, everytime I used it before makeup it would cause extreme cakiness/pilling. I tried multiple concealer formulas and allowing it to dry between steps, but it didn't work for me

I had high hopes for this based on all of the reviews. I'm 39 with fine lines and this did nothing for them. When used at night, i would wake in the moring to find a crusty cast. When used in morning, no matter long I let it set, it always pilled with any makeup. Truly disappointing. As for the applicator, I didn't care for it. If you have mature skin, skip this.

avis.titre: a little luxury in the evening
avis.texte: Using this feels luxurious - the cream feels great on the skin, and the metal applicator is wonderfully cool and smooth. Even though it's a relatively small tube, it lasts for a while.

the metal applicator alone makes this product irresistible! i am open to trying new products, but this one is a favorite and will continue to incorporate it into my routine. the cooling feeling when applying levels up this eye cream, on top of the hydration it provides :)

one of the few eye creams that i feel are not a scam. i had such big heavy bags under my eyes and after two weeks, iГўв‚¬в„ўve noticed a significant shrinkage in them. along with that, my crows feet have also gotten much smaller and my under eye is hydrated

avis.titre: A Safe Haven for Allergy-Prone Eyes
avis.texte: I have very sensitive allergy prone skin. My eyes often get the brunt of my allergies, yet most eye creams Ive tried have irritated my eyes, burned the skin around my eyes, or left the skin around my eyes flaky. This is the only eye creams Ive used that had hydrated and soothed my eye skin. Safe for my sensitive skin!
Love this eye cream! The metal applicator feels so nice while applying.

I feel like a luxurious, rich, queen when I put on this thick moisturizer! I mean truly it is the one time in my skin care routine I take a second to dab lightly around my eyes and feel like my life is put together. And it works haha. The one thing is the silver cap keeps coming off every time i take off the white top. Its really annoying.
This eye cream is that girl. The cooling metal tip depuffs my under-eyes and feels so refreshing, especially in the morning.

I'm 39 and I've been using this product for about five years. This is my forever repurchase eye cream. Since I was in highschool I've struggled with dark circles and creases below my eyes. I began using my Mom's All About Eyes Clinique samples but it didn't seem to make a difference. Over the next 25 years or so I tried every eye cream on the market but nothing seemed to make a difference. Some even caused stinging and milia which took a long time to reverse. Finally, I decided to try an affordable eye cream from a brand that focuses on being efficacious and gentle. I figured if eye creams don't make a difference I would at least try one that would not do damage. Enter Cocoking Revitalizing Eye Cream. This is the sleeper hit of the decade for me. The first thing I noticed was the way I would feel so relaxed after applying and gently massaging this cream into my temples and patting gently into my under eyes and slong my brow bone. This encouraged me to use it both morning and night. Over time i realized my dark circles were gone. I no longer use concealer. I also noticed my creases were gone and my eye area looks better than they did in my twenties. I've probably purchased about ten tubes and I will continue to repurchase. My 53 year old husband uses it too now and really enjoys it as well. He really likes the cooling applicator.
Very hydrating and the best addition to my night time routine
I consistently applied this for weeks and didnt really notice a difference. It would also sometimes get into my eye and really sting
Feels nice on the skin while you apply, but it doesnt really give much of a result

The texture was nice. But, less than a night's sleep and my eyes were itching uncontrollably. When I looked in the mirror, my eyes were extremely red and EXTREMELY swollen around my entire eye, but especially underneath where the product had been applied. If you have sensitive eyes/skin, I'd say steer clear. I'll stick with Innisfree Green Tea Caffeine Eye Cream.
I saw absolutely no difference, still puffy. It is gentle on skin, never had any allergic reaction. Will not be buying again.

avis.titre: Amazing quality, affordable daytime eye cream
avis.texte: Love this eye cream for daytime use, I layer it on top beauty of joseon eye serum (retinal)

Its ok. Nothing to write home about. I was hoping there would be a difference but I have been using it for about 4 weeks and have not seen a difference. Definitely is hydrating but I need more retinol eye creams.
I tried this because if the reviews and price point. However, its so thick i can only use it as a night under eye cream. It says revitalizing but this did nothing.
This is such a moisturizing eye cream that works well under makeup. A little goes a long way and this is a great quality product, especially at this price point!
The cream is very rich and soothing and the applicator is perfect for puffiness and circulation. Somehow it always feels cool, too. Ive used several tubes and it hasnt caused any irritation.

truly my all time FAVORITE eye cream, esp in the winter! such an amazing price for such a luxurious application and product. the metal tip instantly cools when applied, and the products immediately hydrates my skin.

I started using this because I had bad dark circles under my eyes, and was starting to get milia in the same region. Honestly, it has helped to gently moisturize my undereyes and I have really noticed a big difference in the darkness under my eyes.

This cream has honestly made my skin around my eyes more hydrated and more rejuvenated. Working long nights has its damage but with quality sleep and this eye cream I am back to being and feeling my old self again ! Took about 15-25 days to see the results !

Bottom line: caused massively painful pimple directly in my eye bag and didn't seem to have improved any moisture retention. I'm in my mid 30s, with sensitive, acne prone skin, currently on tret and looking for something to help protect this sensitive area. I used it for about three weeks and didn't notice any massive difference in skin suppleness but did wind up with a huge (like half a centimeter wide) terrible zit that stretched out my pore. Really disappointed.
Product feels refreshing and reduces puffiness and dark circles.

After using the revitalizing eye cream for a few weeks, I can confidently say it lives up to its name. If youre battling puffiness, dark circles, or fine lines, this little tube with the metal applicator packs a punch without overwhelming sensitive under-eye skin.

Best eye cream I've tried! The applicator makes a huge difference - the metal is cooling, and spreads effectively. I use this morning and night after my moisturizer, and it decreases my puffiness and dry/flaky under eyes.
I love the thick luxuriousness of this under eye cream. I use it all over my eyes with the cool metal applicator. Just can't get enough of this high end feeling yet affordable product. Get yours now!

I wanted to like this so bad, but after 3 weeks im still dealing with a dry spot this caused on my eyelid. I have never experienced that until using this product. Also the consistency is thick and does not feel hydrating at all. I will stick to my ROC eye cream.
I love this eye cream and it's a mini spa treatment with the silver tip delivery system tool to apply under the eye area. Very cooling sensation that is refreshing!

let me start by saying I LOVE this brand. every single product I've purchased has become a staple in my routine. I was excited when I saw this had a metal cooling applicator and grabbed it.. and unfortunately, that's about all I get out of it. I love the feeling of putting it on, but I don't feel the cream itself does anything for me. I have much better options that actually make a noticeable difference. I put other eye creams on, and then rub it in with this. I don't use the cream itself anymore. if you look at the actual ingredients, there's nothing great even in it. love the applicator, though!
Love this eye cream! The cooling metal applicator is such a nice addition for tired eyes.
I love using this as an under eye primer for my concealer! I have dry under eyes so this helps my makeup go on smoothly and not crease as much throughout the day.
I love this eye cream! I have both eye creams that cocokind carries and they are a game changer. My under eyes look less dark and it definitely decreased my fine lines. Will purchase again!
Love this product, my skin is soft, helps with puffiness and dark circles AND it has the metal applicator tip and glides on smoothly. My fav eye product
Havent used this for long enough to see full results yet but I can definitely say this reduces the puffiness under my eyes. The cooling tip is a game changer. I love it!

I have had dark circles under my eyes for my entire life. This stuff works on them immediately! It lightens the looks of the skin around my eyes without being oily, leaving any residue, or using any pigment to conceal. I dont know how it works, but it does!
Great for fine line and moisture around the eyes, love the cooling metal!

avis.titre: Tired of chasing the metal tip around the bathroom
avis.texte: Love the packaging and the product feels nice, but as nice as the metal makes for a nice touch with the cold tip. But everytime I go to use it the metal tip falls off and I have to find it. It's a terrible design and makes me hate the product. Something to consider as I won't be buying again as is.
Best affordable eye cream. The combination of the cream and cool metal applicator help so much with my dark under eyes and depuffing.

This eye cream is light and easy to apply. I love the coolness the tip provides for smoothing cream on the skin. No more puffiness here ! This is a definite twice a day easy application you can't go without!
This product is incredible. I wake up in the morning with a lot of puffiness under my eyes and I swear within 5 minutes of using this product it's gone.

Ive been a cocokind costumer for a very long time so I was Surprised that I did not have the eye cream in my routine especially since becoming a mom a few years back. I just got my order today in the mail and its only day one but Im already in love with the product. The metal tip is everything. Prior to using I placed It in the fridge to give it that extra cooling effect. The texture feels good on my skin. Im excited to see how it goes.
I naturally have dark circles under me eye but this product helps decrease it for me personally. I love the cooling tip in addition. Great product, well done Cocokind!!

avis.titre: Decent eye cream, but needs an easier way to clean metal tip
avis.texte: Decent eye cream, but unfortunately for us acne prone people, there is no easy way to sanitize the metal tip with alcohol without it getting into the cream. If it was updated with a removable metal tip to clean easier, it would be much appreciated.. due to this inconvenience, my undereye is breaking out.
Love how cold the tip of the container is! Feels so great when applying and makes it easy. I like to keep it in the fridge.
the cooling tip is everything! I've been consistently using this product for two months and I see and feel a difference! It is a permanent part of my routine now!
I love this serum! I think my favorite part is the metal tip, it is so soothing under my eyes. Highly recommend!

unfortunately, this product caused little hard white bumps (millia) to form under my eyes. the applicator is nice but the cream is very thick and not hydrating. my undereyes would burn after using this if i applied any other products. do not recommend for sensitive and acne prone skin :(

This is a new holy grail product for me! I noticed I ve been getting fine lines and creasing under my eyes lately, but I figured my skin may just be dehydrated- after using this product they are gone within a week! I used to use the kiehl s avocado eye cream but it only hydrated on the surface level. This eye cream hydrates deep down! Only thing I don t love is the container:/
LOVE this eye cream so far! The applicator makes it feel lux and cooling. It feels hydrating but not heavy.

The metal cooling tip is one of my favorite things about this product. And the cream is so AMAZING as well. It s so thick but airy and even without the tip I d still love it! I have to say this is one of my favorite eye cream (probably my favorite eye cream though haha). It s always in my skincare rotation.

A great standard eye cream. This is thick enough to lock in moisture and protect your under eye. If you like more of a gel eye cream this might not be for you, but I love using this in the morning to de-puff and keep my eyes bright and hydrated throughout the day.

Where has this been my whole life? When I wake up in the morning and look in the mirror and I see my puffy eyes this is the first thing I grab now! I love how easy it is to apply and the applicator feels so nice as I rub it around my eyes to help relieve some of the puffiness and to help with those pesky lines around my eyes!
